description: Mindclade estate-wide Renovate policy. Every repository extends this preset.
Dependency pull requests always take normal review and the same required checks
as any other change; this preset never enables automerge.

schedule: before 06:00 on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: First-party reusable workflows and composite actions are re-pinned by the estate release process, never by Renovate. The governance policy github-config/policy/workflow_sources.rego requires a bare 40-hex ref with no version comment; a Renovate update would append one and fail policy.
Group compatible minor and patch updates per manager so one review covers them.
Majors stay separate and individually reviewable.
Resolve OpenTofu providers from the OpenTofu registry rather than the Terraform registry.
Keep every GitHub Actions reference pinned to a commit SHA with a version comment; the organization Actions policy sets sha_pinning_required.
Keep container references pinned by digest.
Nix flake input support is still beta upstream; keep it enabled but grouped and clearly labelled.
Commit-message prefixes preserve the per-ecosystem convention the estate already used.
